{"type":"thought","data":"The match is Aris Thessaloniki"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus Atromitos in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Greek Super League"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on October 25, 2026"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 19:30 local time."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market closes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 17:30 UTC, which "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is the kickoff time."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Aris Thessaloniki sits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fifth with 13 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and a -3 goal difference,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Atromitos is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"last with only 2 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and a -4 goal difference."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The match will be held"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at Kleanthis Vikelidis"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Stadium."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAris has an unbeaten"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home record this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Their recent form includes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins over Kifisia and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Volos. Atromitos has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" no wins in six games."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Bookmakers and models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate Aris at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 57% to 60%. The market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 0.585 is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above these estimates."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market is efficiently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" priced with almost "}
{"type":"thought","data":"no edge. The goal is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pick the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely to be correct,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not necessarily the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear. A correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet returns 100 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A wrong bet loses the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" full 100 stake. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the probability of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being reverse-engineered"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from historical results."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A correct bet on Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.585 returns roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 71 tokens, while a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"correct No bet returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 141 tokens. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price reflects the inverse"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of the payout ratio."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now fully understood."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A correct bet returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100 tokens multiplied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by the inverse of the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price. Higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdog prices therefore"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yield larger payouts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if they win.\n\nThe phrase"}
{"type":"thought","data":" \"most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" is ambiguous. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"It could mean the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of being correct, or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it could mean the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value. Because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the competition scores"}
{"type":"thought","data":" based on P&L, expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value is likely the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relevant metric."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calculation confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the break-even point."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A correct bet on Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only pays off if the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" true probability exceeds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.585, and a correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on No only pays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off if it falls below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that threshold. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" means the choice between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcomes depends entirely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on whether the actual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability is higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or lower than the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will check more "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reliable sports sites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for precise odds and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team news. The bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overround is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5 to 8 percent. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gap between the two"}
{"type":"thought","data":" teams is stark on paper."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Atromitos has zero "}
{"type":"thought","data":"wins in six games while Aris has seven."}
